$comment: The issue tracker's labels. .github/workflows/labels.yml applies this file: each label gets exactly this name, colour and description, and every name under 'from' is folded into it (its issues relabelled, the old label deleted). Each family shares one hue so a row of labels reads at a glance: class is blue (darker is sooner), severity runs hot to cool, kind is teal, found-by is violet, area is slate, and the two meta labels stand apart. CLAUDE.md holds the rules the labels express.

labels.name: blocker
labels.description: Class · fix first: data loss, crash, leak, regression, or a claimed workflow broken

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Class · a capability not yet claimed; starts when no blocker is open

labels.name: deferred
labels.description: Class · real but off the normal path; rides in a change touching its files

labels.name: P0
labels.description: Severity · data loss or corruption, unrecoverable damage, critical crash: stop the line

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Severity · major correctness or stability failure; a workflow cannot reliably complete

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Severity · user-visible functional defect; a workflow obstructed but recoverable

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Severity · low-impact debt, hygiene or cosmetics

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Kind · a defect: the engine does something wrong

labels.name: tech-debt
labels.description: Kind · a weakness with no active defect: design, coverage, duplication, performance

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Found · introduced by an earlier change; the count is the health signal

labels.name: observed
labels.description: Found · seen running the engine, or in CI

labels.name: audit
labels.description: Found · by an audit or code reading

labels.name: core
labels.description: Area · bootstrap, jobs, VFS, logging, cvars, input, JSON, shared primitives

labels.name: math
labels.description: Area · vectors, matrices, bounds, deterministic scalar maths

labels.name: platform
labels.description: Area · SDL glue, windows, OS paths, per-platform builds

labels.name: content
labels.description: Area · asset identity, catalog, cook, streaming, project files

labels.name: render
labels.description: Area · renderer, shaders, materials, RenderDevice

labels.name: physics
labels.description: Area · bodies, colliders, contacts, joints, queries

labels.name: audio
labels.description: Area · sounds, music, buses, voices

labels.name: scripting
labels.description: Area · Lua VM, sandbox, bindings, hot reload

labels.name: runtime
labels.description: Area · World, frame pipeline, scene and prefab I/O, bridges

labels.name: editor
labels.description: Area · editor panels, tools, undo, play-in-editor

labels.name: tools-ci
labels.description: Area · asset packer, gates, CI, build system

labels.name: docs
labels.description: Area · README, docs/, decisions, skills

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Meta · lacks exactly one class label (blocker, deferred or feature)

labels.name: roadmap
labels.description: Meta · the pinned fix-order index: start here
